title: Added support for two new PIM message Types(rfc9465)
description:
Problem:
This is an enhancement to accommodate the new packet types defined in RFC9465.
Component is PIM - Protocol Independent Multicast. So far, PIM has 12 Message
Types defined. The Two new types are 13.0 and 13.1. Also IANA assigned a special
Bit in the existing Register-Stop message (Type 2) to advertise RFC9465 protocol
support to other routers.

Note:
Up until PIM message type 12, only 4 bits were used to identify a PIM message.
This is the “Type” field. However this is proving to be insufficient for
Increasing number of types, hence IANA is now assigning the Subtype (4 bits)
Field as well to identify new and future PIM messages.

The new message types are PIM Packed Null-Register message (Type 13.0)
and  PIM Packed Register-Stop message (Type 13.1).
Each of these messages also have (G,S) information, in a batched format.
Kindly check the “overview section”, added screenshots of how output looks like.

Also, PIM_BIDIR_RSVD is not being used anywhere, made it
A generic macro to extract subtype  that can be used
for all packet types in the future.

**Fix:2 (Commit ID: 39128ba51b672678ec3db3b5a2e87f89316982b6):**

 error: 'typestr' may be used uninitialized [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
 1127 |     col_add_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, typestr);
      |     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/builds/agopal4/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-pim.c:1096:17: 
 note: 'typestr' was declared here
 1096 |     const char *typestr;

RCA: 
All change are in PIM dissector only. Fixed a static analysis bug 
where if the Packet type is greater than 13, then the “typestr” is 
used un-initialized. 
This is a negative case since there are only 13 known packet types 
According to 
https://www.iana.org/assignments/pim-parameters/pim-parameters.xhtml
Section: PIM Message Types.

Fix:
If PIM version is 2 and packet type  > 13, print “Unknown”.

**pcap files: **
With Type 2, P-bit setting -- [p_bit_set_reg.pcap](/uploads/a409e3129120e544833d6861fbb0d7ce/p_bit_set_reg.pcap)
With Packet Type 13.0 and 13.1 -- [packed_registers.pcap](/uploads/2b077f9e5fbf3cd9f884ebcc4c94df46/packed_registers.pcap)
